text:
Stefano Moshi was succeeded as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania by Erasto Kweka, which corrects my earlier answer. As I recall it, Kweka served from about 1976 to 1979. Sebastian Kolowa and then Samson Mushemba came after him, so Mushemba was a later presiding bishop, not Moshi's direct successor. This is from memory, and I haven't verified it.

CONFIDENCE: 72
